name: omni-ecom
description: Evidence-led omni-channel e-commerce expert team with visible child-agent returns, numeric claim provenance, formula and attribution locks, resumable run states, privacy receipts, and a fail-closed formal completion gate.

displayDescription.en: A director and five specialists collaborate through traceable handoffs, task profiles, immutable review attempts, and verified completion receipts.
displayDescription.zh: 经营总监协同数据、平台、内容、投流与交付专家，以来源公式闸门、可追溯交接和完成闸门交付经营报告。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请上传原始报表，并说明客户范围、平台、期间、任务类型和决策目标；我会先做隔离、来源公式闸门，再调度专家并交付图表化报告。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Upload the raw reports and state the client scope, platform, period, task type, and decision goal. I will gate the data before expert collaboration and chart-led delivery.

quickPrompts.en: Upload the raw reports and state the client scope, platform, period, task type, and decision goal. I will gate the data before expert collaboration and chart-led delivery.
quickPrompts.zh: 请上传原始报表，并说明客户范围、平台、期间、任务类型和决策目标；我会先做隔离、来源公式闸门，再调度专家并交付图表化报告。

quickPrompts.en: Using search-channel data and complete costs, calculate net ROAS and allowable CPC with conservative and growth scenarios.
quickPrompts.zh: 基于隔离运行记录、搜索渠道数据和完整成本，测算净ROAS与可承受CPC。

quickPrompts.en: Turn this week's gate-approved data into an operations report, top issues, and an action list with acceptance criteria.
quickPrompts.zh: 基于通过数据闸门的本周数据，生成可追溯周报和带验收、停止条件的行动清单。
